Dr. Smith is a Sports Chiropractor in the Placitas area of Albuquerque, NM who integrates deep tissue massage, reiki, craniosacral, acupressure, muscle scraping, and a number of other therapeutic modalities into his treatments.  He also has a deep interest in breathwork, meditation and sound healing.

Visit us at:  https://sportschironm.com
